Object Brush 万物画笔

Draw With Anything. 万物皆可作画。

Core idea

Reality Becomes the Brush

Users do not need to learn a complex interface. They simply pick up ordinary desk objects. AI recognizes what the object is, reads its shape, color, and everyday meaning, then transforms it into a digital brush. As the object moves, its path becomes strokes; when it pauses, swings, or combines with other objects, those strokes slowly grow into an illustrated world.

Brush types

Four Everyday Brushes

Each brush acts like a hand-drawn sticker note: simple to understand, visually distinct, and easy to extend with custom illustration assets.

Ink Brush

Pen / Chopsticks

Waving creates ink lines, soft clouds, small mountains, and birds that appear as if sketched with a pencil.

Watercolor Brush

Cup

Movement leaves watercolor blooms, puddles, fish, lotus leaves, and bubbles drifting from the wet edge.

Pixel Brush

Phone

Movement builds pixel blocks, tiny windows, and small cities, while keeping a handmade sticker-pixel look.

Vine Brush

Banana / Yellow object

Movement grows vines, flowers, little stars, and connective plant trails across the whole canvas.

Interaction flow

From Object to World

The interaction should feel like an illustrated scene slowly appearing, not like a technological scan. Each step is visible, playful, and understandable.

1
Camera sees the object 摄像头捕捉桌面上的真实物品。
2
AI names the object AI 识别它是笔、杯子、手机或香蕉。
3
The object becomes a brush 系统映射语义、形状和视觉规则。
4
Movement becomes strokes 物品中心点轨迹变成手绘笔触。
5
Strokes grow into a world 笔触生长成花、鱼、云、山和星星。
Technical plan

Simple, Buildable Stack

The prototype can run fully in the browser, using lightweight recognition and canvas rendering before adding more advanced AI behaviors.

Camera Input

Reads the live video stream from a web camera.

getUserMedia

Object Recognition

Classifies common desk objects with a lightweight model.

MediaPipe / TensorFlow.js

Motion Tracking

Tracks the object center point and turns movement into strokes.

center point tracking

Visual Engine

Renders trails, particles, growth animation, and layered scenes.

Canvas / p5.js / PixiJS

Hand-drawn Assets

Uses transparent illustration layers for flowers, fish, clouds, mountains, and stickers.

PNG / SVG layers

AI Layer

Maps object semantics to brush rules, fusion behaviors, and optional captions.

semantics + rules
Project highlights

Why It Works

Low Barrier

Users only need to pick up objects they already have on the desk.

Strong Visual Impact

Real-time movement turns into a hand-drawn world that visibly grows.

Personal Style

Creators can replace brush assets with their own illustrated PNG or SVG layers.

Scalable System

More objects, brush rules, and fusion recipes can be added over time.

Closing

Everyday Objects, Magical Interfaces.

Object Brush turns ordinary desk objects into creative instruments. It is not just a camera interaction demo, but a playful interface where AI understands the real world and transforms it into a living illustrated canvas.
